title: Shell
body:
Used to navigate workspace and access [[EMACS]]
***Commands***
-o 
output file

`cat

`cp <relative_dir/> <filename>`
copy file 

`who
shows everyone on network

`ctrl + d
boots you out :)

`ls  -al
list all

`script
opens another terminal, saves in a typescript file.

`ctrl + j
Suspends program

`jobs
Shows abount of programs running

``.*
Any character
-Relative vs actual path

`cd /users/dir/`
`alias go_to_dir = "cd /users/dir/"`
Basically used as shorthand so you dont have to write a super long command everytime.
so `go_to_dir` will run the command on the other side of the = sign.

***Printing code:***
`lpr filename.cpp
prints text 

`lpr -p lp1 filename.cpp
Prints from a specific printer (lp0 or lp1)

`lpq
Checks printer queue 

***submitting assignments***

`submit ` 

Edditing [[Bash file]]
after bin add :.
`PATH=$PATH:$HOME/BIN:.
